sources.title: Skills | Google Antigravity Docs
sources.snippet: Workspace skills are great for project-specific workflows, like your team's deployment process or testing conventions. Global skills work across all your projects. Use these for personal utilities or general-purpose tools you want everywhere. Note: Antigravity now defaults to .agents/skills, but still maintains backward support for .agent/skills.

sources.title: Antigravity Skills | Build and discover AI agent skills
sources.snippet: Build an AI agent skill from an idea or browse the published Antigravity Skills library. Skills use the SKILL.md format.
